title: Wardrobes
status: Draft – no wardrobe ITP in QA Records Task; confirm the right ITP
itp: No wardrobe ITP found – based on kitchen & joinery ITPs

questions.q: Are carcasses level, plumb and securely fixed (into pattresses)?
Are doors aligned with even gaps; soft-close and hinges adjusted?
Are internal fittings (rails, drawers, lighting) complete and working?
Scribes to walls/ceilings tight, finish undamaged and protected?
Ask the fitter: What scribe gap are you working to at walls and ceiling? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

notOk.t: Excessive or uneven gaps to walls, ceiling and floor
Mirror doors not flush with each other / springing on hinges
Screw heads visible above or inside wardrobes
Veneer chipped, glue marks, gaps at corners
Loose shelves, brackets or fronts; lights not fitted
Drawer front veining not continuous where specified

ask.q: What gap to walls and ceiling?
ask.a: Even scribe – as the joinery detail.
Concealed fixings into solid background or pattressing.
Yes – even gaps, close smoothly, no rubbing.
